text:
Nina: Heads up — Marin ferry (Route 4) is canceled this morning, flooded ramp at the terminal. anyone stuck coming from Sausalito? :umbrella:
Jay: Yep, stuck near 2nd & market. Muni shuttle line is chaos, +25 min. anyone else seeing this?
Sam: Walked to Embarcadero and the water was up to the benches. soaked my sneakers. :sweat_smile:
Tess: I can do a quick carpool run at 8:20 if someone needs a lift — have room for 2. ping me.
Jay: @Tess that would be life-saving. saving my shoes. :pray:
Alex: Heads-up for scooter commuters: underpass at Folsom is flooded, had to detour via 5th. added like 20m. recommend stashing scooters and walking the last block.
DevOpsBot: Ferry status update: Route 4 suspended until 10:00 AM due to ramp flooding. Shuttle replacements in effect. More: https://status.redwood.ai/ferry
Nina: Also saw a couple people doing the classic puddle-sprint. 0/10 would recommend unless you like soggy clothes. :grimacing: 
Sam: Can anyone on dedicated give a heads-up to the meetings? Might be 10–15 late.
Tess: Picking up @Jay and @Sam — meet at 7th & Mission in ~10.
Alex: Coffee on me for the brave puddle-sprinters at the office kiosk. :coffee:
Jay: I accept the coffee. bringing soggy socks as proof.
Nina: Lol, thanks all. if anyone else needs a pickup, shout here and I’ll try to reroute my walk.
Sam: BART FYI — Richmond line reporting slowdowns too (downed tree). seems like the whole corridor is having morning drama.
Tess: Quick note: if you’re remote and need to push, DM your lead. no one should risk the commute for a standup. :heart:
Alex: Also FYI — scooter detour map snippet I took:
```
Detour: Folsom -> 5th -> Market
Avoid: Embarcadero underpass
Extra time: ~15-25m
```
Nina: Stay safe everyone. see you (hopefully drier) soon. :boat:
